unit.title: Data
unit.blurb: Collecting data with tally marks, reading pictograms where a picture can stand for 2, reading block graphs, and sorting with Carroll diagrams.
unit.subject: maths

O1.t: Record and read data in tallies and pictograms.

O2.t: Read block graphs and sort numbers and objects in diagrams.

p: We make a **tally** mark for each thing we count. Every **fifth** mark goes across the other four, so we can count in 5s: 卌 = 5.
In some pictograms, one picture stands for **2**. Half a picture stands for 1. Always read the **key**.

p: A **block graph** shows each thing as a block. The **tallest** column is the most popular. Read across from the top of a column to the scale.
A **Carroll diagram** sorts things by a rule, such as **even** / **not even**, or **more than 10** / **not more than 10**.
